regular-home-cleaning.name: Regular Home Cleaning
regular-home-cleaning.shortDescription: Ongoing weekly, bi-weekly or monthly cleaning that keeps your home consistently spotless.
regular-home-cleaning.problem: Keeping a home clean week after week takes time you'd rather spend elsewhere.
regular-home-cleaning.solution: A recurring cleaning schedule tailored to your property, with the same standard every visit.
excludes: Laundry and ironing (available as an extra)
Interior oven and fridge cleaning (available as an extra)
regular-home-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, villas and townhouses that need consistent upkeep.
regular-home-cleaning.recommendedFrequency: Weekly or bi-weekly for most households.
process: Confirm your schedule and access details
Our team arrives within your selected window
preparation: Clear valuables and important documents
Let us know about pets in advance
Share any access instructions ahead of the first visit

one-time-home-cleaning.name: One-Time Home Cleaning
one-time-home-cleaning.shortDescription: A single thorough clean for special occasions, guests, or a fresh start — no commitment required.
one-time-home-cleaning.problem: Sometimes you need a spotless home once, without setting up an ongoing plan.
one-time-home-cleaning.solution: A single comprehensive cleaning visit sized to your property.
excludes: Deep-clean tasks such as inside cupboards or ovens (see Deep Cleaning)
one-time-home-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, villas and townhouses needing a one-off refresh.
preparation: Tidy away personal items you'd prefer untouched
Ensure clear access to all rooms

deep-cleaning.name: Deep Cleaning
deep-cleaning.shortDescription: An intensive, top-to-bottom clean covering the details a regular clean doesn't reach.
deep-cleaning.problem: Regular cleaning maintains a home, but grime builds up in places that need extra attention.
deep-cleaning.solution: A detailed deep clean covering skirting boards, interior cupboards, appliances and more.
deep-cleaning.idealFor: Homes that haven't been professionally cleaned recently, or before/after a big event.
deep-cleaning.recommendedFrequency: Every 3–6 months, or before/after a change in occupancy.
preparation: Clear surfaces and cupboards you'd like cleaned
Note any areas needing special attention

holiday-rental-cleaning.name: Holiday Rental & Airbnb Cleaning
holiday-rental-cleaning.shortDescription: Fast, reliable turnover cleaning between guests, with optional linen change and guest-ready checks.
holiday-rental-cleaning.problem: Short-notice guest turnovers leave little room for error — the property must be guest-ready every time.
holiday-rental-cleaning.solution: Structured turnover cleaning built around your check-out and check-in times.
excludes: Linen laundering off-site (available as an extra)
Restocking of guest consumables (available as an extra)
holiday-rental-cleaning.idealFor: Airbnb, Booking.com and other short-term rental properties.
preparation: Share your booking calendar or turnover dates
Provide access instructions in advance

move-in-move-out-cleaning.name: Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
move-in-move-out-cleaning.shortDescription: A thorough clean for an empty property, ready for new occupants or a handover.
move-in-move-out-cleaning.problem: Moving is stressful enough without also deep-cleaning an entire property.
move-in-move-out-cleaning.solution: A detailed empty-property clean covering every room, cupboard and surface.
move-in-move-out-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, villas, townhouses and offices at the start or end of a tenancy.
process: Full deep clean of every room
preparation: Ensure the property is empty of belongings
Arrange utilities so water/electricity are available

post-construction-cleaning.name: Post-Construction Cleaning
post-construction-cleaning.shortDescription: Specialist cleaning to remove dust, debris and residue after building or renovation work.
post-construction-cleaning.problem: Construction dust settles everywhere and requires specialist removal, not a standard clean.
post-construction-cleaning.solution: A dedicated post-construction clean using appropriate tools and techniques.
includes: Fine dust removal from all surfaces
Removal of construction residue and stickers
excludes: Removal of construction debris or waste materials
post-construction-cleaning.idealFor: Newly built or renovated apartments, villas, offices and commercial units.
preparation: Ensure major construction waste is already removed
Confirm safe access for our team

office-commercial-cleaning.name: Office & Commercial Cleaning
office-commercial-cleaning.shortDescription: Recurring cleaning for offices and commercial premises on a schedule that fits your business.
office-commercial-cleaning.problem: A clean workplace matters for staff and clients, but daily operations can't be disrupted.
office-commercial-cleaning.solution: Flexible, scheduled commercial cleaning outside or around business hours.
office-commercial-cleaning.idealFor: Offices, real estate agencies, showrooms and small commercial premises.
office-commercial-cleaning.recommendedFrequency: Daily, weekly or custom recurring contracts.
preparation: Provide access arrangements for out-of-hours cleaning
Flag any restricted or sensitive areas

villa-luxury-property-cleaning.name: Villa & Luxury Property Cleaning
villa-luxury-property-cleaning.shortDescription: Detailed, discreet cleaning for larger villas and premium properties.
villa-luxury-property-cleaning.problem: Larger, high-end properties need a meticulous approach and discretion.
villa-luxury-property-cleaning.solution: A tailored cleaning plan sized to your villa's layout, finishes and expectations.
villa-luxury-property-cleaning.idealFor: Villas, luxury homes and premium holiday properties.
process: Property walkthrough to understand layout and finishes
preparation: Share any specific-care instructions for materials or finishes
Confirm access and alarm arrangements

community-common-area-cleaning.name: Community & Common-Area Cleaning
community-common-area-cleaning.shortDescription: Cleaning for shared entrances, stairwells, corridors and communal facilities.
community-common-area-cleaning.problem: Shared spaces in residential communities need consistent upkeep for all residents.
community-common-area-cleaning.solution: A scheduled cleaning contract for entrances, stairwells and communal areas.
community-common-area-cleaning.idealFor: Residential communities, urbanisations and property-management portfolios.
process: Site walkthrough with the community administrator
preparation: Provide access to communal areas
Confirm the point of contact for the community

window-cleaning.name: Window Cleaning
window-cleaning.shortDescription: Interior and exterior window cleaning for a brighter, streak-free view.
window-cleaning.problem: Windows accumulate dust, salt air and grime that regular cleaning doesn't address.
window-cleaning.solution: Dedicated interior and/or exterior window cleaning using appropriate equipment.
excludes: High-access exterior cleaning requiring special equipment (quoted separately)
window-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, villas, townhouses, offices and commercial premises.
preparation: Clear window sills of items
Confirm exterior access where relevant

upholstery-sofa-cleaning.name: Upholstery & Sofa Cleaning
upholstery-sofa-cleaning.shortDescription: Professional cleaning to refresh sofas and upholstered furniture.
upholstery-sofa-cleaning.problem: Upholstery absorbs dust, odours and stains that a normal clean can't lift.
upholstery-sofa-cleaning.solution: Specialist upholstery cleaning suited to your fabric type.
excludes: Leather-specific conditioning (available on request as a quote)
upholstery-sofa-cleaning.idealFor: Sofas, armchairs and upholstered furniture in homes and rentals.
preparation: Remove cushions and loose items beforehand

mattress-cleaning.name: Mattress Cleaning
mattress-cleaning.shortDescription: Deep cleaning to freshen mattresses and address dust, allergens and stains.
mattress-cleaning.problem: Mattresses are rarely cleaned but accumulate dust and allergens over time.
mattress-cleaning.solution: A dedicated mattress cleaning treatment, including stain and odour treatment.
mattress-cleaning.idealFor: Bedrooms in homes, rentals and holiday properties.
mattress-cleaning.recommendedFrequency: Every 6–12 months, or between long-term tenants.
preparation: Strip bedding before our arrival

terrace-outdoor-cleaning.name: Terrace & Outdoor-Area Cleaning
terrace-outdoor-cleaning.shortDescription: Cleaning for terraces, balconies and outdoor living spaces exposed to the elements.
terrace-outdoor-cleaning.problem: Terraces face dust, pollen and weather that build up faster than indoor spaces.
terrace-outdoor-cleaning.solution: A thorough terrace and outdoor-area clean, including furniture wipe-down.

terrace-outdoor-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, villas and townhouses with terraces or balconies.

guest-arrival-preparation.name: Property Preparation Before Guest Arrival
guest-arrival-preparation.shortDescription: A final guest-ready check and refresh before check-in.
guest-arrival-preparation.problem: Even a cleaned property needs a final check to feel truly guest-ready.
guest-arrival-preparation.solution: A pre-arrival preparation visit covering presentation, amenities and final touches.

guest-arrival-preparation.idealFor: Holiday rentals and short-term let properties.

linen-towel-change.name: Linen & Towel Change
linen-towel-change.shortDescription: Fresh linen and towels changed between guests or on a set schedule.
linen-towel-change.problem: Guests and residents expect fresh linen every stay, which takes coordinated logistics.
linen-towel-change.solution: Linen and towel changes coordinated with your cleaning or turnover schedule.
linen-towel-change.idealFor: Holiday rentals, guest rooms and recurring residential cleaning.
linen-towel-change.recommendedFrequency: Each turnover, or weekly for residential.
process: Strip and replace linen and towels
preparation: Provide spare linen sets on-site, or arrange laundering separately

ironing.name: Ironing
ironing.shortDescription: Professional ironing for clothing and household linen.
ironing.problem: Ironing takes time many households would rather spend elsewhere.
ironing.solution: Ironing handled as part of your cleaning visit or as a standalone add-on.

ironing.idealFor: Homes and holiday rentals needing linen or clothing pressed.

fridge-cleaning.name: Fridge Cleaning
fridge-cleaning.shortDescription: Interior and exterior fridge cleaning, including shelves and compartments.
fridge-cleaning.problem: Fridges need periodic deep cleaning that a quick wipe-down doesn't achieve.

fridge-cleaning.idealFor: Homes and holiday rentals between tenants or guests.

oven-cleaning.name: Oven Cleaning
oven-cleaning.shortDescription: Deep cleaning to remove baked-on grease and residue from your oven.
oven-cleaning.problem: Ovens accumulate grease that standard kitchen cleaning can't remove.
oven-cleaning.solution: A specialist oven clean covering racks, interior surfaces and glass.
oven-cleaning.idealFor: Homes, holiday rentals and offices with kitchen facilities.

interior-cabinet-cleaning.name: Interior Cabinet Cleaning
interior-cabinet-cleaning.shortDescription: Cleaning inside kitchen and bathroom cabinets, shelves and drawers.
interior-cabinet-cleaning.problem: Cabinet interiors are easy to overlook during a standard clean.
interior-cabinet-cleaning.solution: A dedicated interior cabinet clean for kitchens, bathrooms and storage areas.

interior-cabinet-cleaning.idealFor: Homes, holiday rentals and move-in/move-out cleans.

faq.pageDescription: Answers to common questions about booking, payments, cancellations, access and more.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

how-to-book.q: How do I book a cleaning?
how-to-book.a: Use the Book a Cleaning page to select your service, share property details, choose a date, and submit your request. You'll receive a booking reference and a confirmation email.

booking-confirmation-time.q: How quickly is my booking confirmed?
booking-confirmation-time.a: We review each request and confirm details with you directly. Your submission is a booking request until you receive confirmation — timing depends on the service and date requested.

payment-methods.a: Payment methods will be confirmed with you before your service is completed. Online payment options are being added to the platform.

when-do-i-pay.q: When do I pay for my cleaning?
when-do-i-pay.a: Payment timing (on completion, deposit, or in advance) will be confirmed as part of your booking confirmation.

cancellation-notice.q: How much notice do I need to cancel?
cancellation-notice.a: See our Cancellation Policy page for the current notice period. This will be confirmed and kept up to date.

late-cancellation.q: What happens if I cancel late?
late-cancellation.a: Late cancellation terms are outlined in our Cancellation Policy. Details are confirmed at the time of booking.

do-i-need-to-be-home.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
do-i-need-to-be-home.a: No — many customers provide alternative access such as a key safe, concierge or property manager. You can also choose to be present.

key-safe-support.q: Can I use a key safe or smart lock?
key-safe-support.a: Yes, both are supported access methods. You'll be asked to confirm access details securely after your booking is confirmed, not in the initial public form.

do-you-bring-supplies.q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
do-you-bring-supplies.a: Yes, our team brings professional cleaning products and equipment unless otherwise agreed.

eco-products.a: Eco-friendly product options are being confirmed. Let us know your preference when booking and we'll advise what's available.

pets-at-home.q: Can I book a cleaning if I have pets?
pets-at-home.a: Yes — just let us know about any pets in the property details step so our team is prepared.

parking-availability.q: Is parking required for your team?
parking-availability.a: Street parking or a designated space is helpful but not always required. Let us know about access and parking during booking.

gated-community-access.q: How do you access gated communities or urbanisations?
gated-community-access.a: Provide gate codes, concierge details or visitor instructions during the access-information step so our team can enter smoothly.

recurring-discounts.q: Do recurring bookings get a discount?
recurring-discounts.a: Recurring cleaning may qualify for a discount, shown during booking once pricing is finalised for your plan.

change-recurring-schedule.q: Can I change my recurring schedule later?
change-recurring-schedule.a: Yes — contact us by email, phone or WhatsApp to adjust your frequency or details at any time.

airbnb-turnaround.q: How fast can you turn around an Airbnb between guests?
airbnb-turnaround.a: Turnaround time depends on property size and your schedule. Same-day turnovers may be available and are confirmed case by case.

multi-property-management.q: Can you manage cleaning across multiple properties?
multi-property-management.a: Yes — request a business proposal from the Holiday Rental Cleaning page for multi-property scheduling.

commercial-contracts.q: Do you offer commercial cleaning contracts?
commercial-contracts.a: Yes, with flexible recurring schedules quoted individually for your premises.

office-out-of-hours.q: Can office cleaning happen outside business hours?
office-out-of-hours.a: Yes, scheduling around your operating hours is part of setting up a commercial cleaning plan.

add-on-pricing.a: Each add-on shows a starting price or quote-required status during booking, based on confirmed pricing where available.

sharing-alarm-codes.q: Is it safe to share my alarm code or access details?
sharing-alarm-codes.a: Sensitive access details are only requested securely after your booking is confirmed, not published or stored in the public booking form.

key-return-process.q: How does key pickup and return work?
key-return-process.a: Key handling is agreed as part of your access-information step and confirmed directly with you before the visit.

same-day-availability.q: Can I book a same-day cleaning?
same-day-availability.a: Same-day requests can be submitted and we'll confirm availability directly — it is not guaranteed until confirmed.

areas-covered.a: Marbella, Nueva Andalucía, Puerto Banús, San Pedro de Alcántara, Benahavís, Estepona, Mijas, Fuengirola, Benalmádena, Málaga and Sotogrande, with more areas being added.

area-not-listed.q: My area isn't listed — can you still help?
area-not-listed.a: Contact us with your location and we'll confirm whether we can accommodate your booking.

not-satisfied.q: What if I'm not satisfied with the cleaning?
not-satisfied.a: Contact us as soon as possible so we can review and address the issue. See our Terms and Conditions for full details.

refund-policy.a: Refund handling is outlined in our Terms and Conditions and Cancellation Policy pages.
